cases.label: stateless dh peers
cases.expr: (() => { const priv = n => crypto.createPrivateKey(K[n + '.private']), pub = n => crypto.createPublicKey(K[n + '.public']), dh = (a, b) => crypto.diffieHellman({ privateKey: priv(a), publicKey: pub(b) }); const out = []; for (const group of ['custom', 'modp1', 'modp14']) for (const y of ['y0', 'y1', 'y2', 'y3', 'y11', 'ym2', 'ym1', 'yp', 'yp1']) { if (K[group + '.' + y + '.public'] === null) { out.push([group, y, 'unreadable']); continue; } try { const s = dh(group + '.fixed', group + '.' + y); out.push([group, y, s.length, s.toString('hex').slice(-16)]); } catch (e) { out.push([group, y, e.name, e.code, e.message, e.library, e.reason, Object.keys(e)]); } } return out; })()
